content.text: You're ready to sell digital products, yet platforms like PayPal and Stripe aren't options in your region. Whether you're in Nigeria, Venezuela, or another country where conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-honest-side-side-2|payment]] processors fail, you need a robust solution. This guide provides the infrastructure to launch your online store, process payments in cryptocurrency, and deliver your products seamlessly. With this setup, you can retain more of your earnings while bypassing high fees associated with platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10% per sale compared to the 0.5% fee from NOWPayments. Let's get your store live without relying on restricted platforms.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-what-actually-how-13. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Digital creators often face barriers when conventional payment platforms are inaccessible. COREMERCH's infrastructure provides a solution that grants you full ownership and control of your online store. By utilizing free hosting and backend services, coupled with NOWPayments for crypto transactions, you avoid the pitfalls of dependency on third-party platforms. This sovereignty ensures that your business can thrive regardless of geographical restrictions or currency fluctuations. The [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-selling-notion-templates-crypto-stripe-12|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]-behind-nowpayments-integration-static-site-crypto-17|The Real]] is designed for creators who refuse to be limited by outdated systems, empowering you to operate independently.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can deploy your digital store, gather essential components. You will need a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting, and access to Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic. Additionally, you should set up a NOWPayments account for crypto payment processing and have a Supabase or Google Sheets instance ready for order management. Finally, prepare your digital products—be it ebooks, courses, or software—ensuring they are ready for automated delivery. These elements create the foundation for your sovereign commerce stack.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Establishing your payment and delivery pipeline is critical. Begin by deploying your chosen infrastructure stack, such as the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack. Integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency processing, allowing you to accept over 300 coins with minimal fees. Next, configure your backend to handle order processing. Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate product delivery upon payment confirmation. This setup ensures that once a customer completes a purchase, they receive their product instantly without manual intervention, streamlining your operations.
Retain more of your earnings by avoiding high platform fees.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is in place, it's time to go live. Publish your website on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, making your digital store accessible. Promote your store through social media or email marketing to attract your first customers. Monitor your payment processing via NOWPayments to ensure transactions are completed successfully. As soon as you receive your first payment, you will experience the efficiency of your setup and the benefits of retaining more of your earnings compared to traditional platforms. This marks the start of your journey as an independent digital creator.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your store operational, focus on scaling your business. Expand your product offerings by adding more digital products to your store. Use the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access additional blueprints and templates for efficient scaling. Analyze customer feedback and sales data to refine your marketing strategies. Consider leveraging social media advertising to reach a broader audience. Your infrastructure allows you to grow without the overhead of subscription fees or reliance on third-party platforms, empowering you to build a sustainable business.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, utilize a sovereign commerce stack that integrates crypto payment solutions. By deploying a system with NOWPayments for payment processing, you can accept various cryptocurrencies while maintaining full ownership over your products and revenue. This architecture ensures you bypass high platform fees and restrictions.
Automate product delivery to enhance customer satisfaction.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook without conventional platforms?

You can sell an ebook by deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack that processes payments through NOWPayments. This allows you to accept crypto payments directly, ensuring you retain ownership of your content and profits.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

Utilize a sovereign commerce infrastructure that circumvents conventional platforms. With NOWPayments, you can accept cryptocurrency payments at a significantly lower fee than platforms like Gumroad, maximizing your profits.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by setting up your own digital store using a sovereign commerce stack. This allows you to manage sales independently and accept payments in cryptocurrency.
What digital products can I sell with this system?

You can sell a wide range of digital products, including ebooks, online courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. The infrastructure is designed to handle any type of digital download.
How do I manage customer orders and delivery?

Customer orders are managed through your backend system, which automates delivery using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. This ensures that customers receive their products immediately upon payment confirmation.
